title: Next-day fire-risk test
absent: Not tested yet. No next-day scorecard is available.
failed: The next-day scorecard could not be read. Results are unavailable.
notTested: Model not tested yet. Baseline results are shown below.
example: Example only. Baseline values come from the Europe test; model rows copy history scores and bootstrap intervals are fabricated. These are not model test results.
experimental: Experimental research prototype. Not an official warning. Follow local authorities (112). The NASA fire-weather index is experimental too.
method: Rankings use the same available spots. Main measure: pooled capture, the share of all eligible new fires caught in the top 5 spots per region and day [U]. Hit rate counts days with at least one catch. Lift compares capture with chance. Brier skill compares probabilities with history; zero means no improvement. Missing scores are not zero.
period: {first} to {last}; {days} weather days [V]. Checked against NOAA-20 new-fire detections.
fwi: the NASA fire-weather index (as shown in GWIS)
modelVerdict: The model caught {capture} of eligible new fires, with a hit on {hit} of fire-positive region-days [V].
claim: More accurate than {baseline} under the registered test rule.
difference: Model minus {baseline}: {difference} percentage points; 95% interval {low} to {high}; {draws} valid weekly bootstrap draws [V].
claimRule: An accuracy claim needs a higher test capture rate and a weekly bootstrap interval entirely above zero, on the grid the app ships: 0.25° (about 28 km). The finer 0.1° run planned in the specification was not made in time.
coverage: Coverage: {scored} of {eligible} eligible spot-days scored; {fires} of {allFires} eligible new fires had scores; {excluded} spot-days and {missingFires} fires lacked scores; {days} region-days had no scores [V].
probabilityCoverage: Probability measures cover {count} scored spot-days on fire-positive region-days [V].
weakIntro: Every month or region where model capture is below any baseline is listed, including small regions. These slices are descriptive, not separate accuracy claims.
noWeak: No measured month or region trails a baseline. Missing slice scores are not evidence of success.
sliceCoverage: {missing} of {total} month and region slices have no model capture score [V].
daily: Daily comparisons are not tested here yet. This section reports the held-out year only.
dailyExplanation: New fire spots in forest and wildland, checked against NOAA-20 satellite detections. The model and NASA fire-weather index are each scored on their top 5 spots per region [U]. Eligible fires without scores remain in the total. The index uses the rounded values published with the forecast. Europe uses the same map bounds as the hold-out test.
dailyShort: Only {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} so far [V].
dailyEmpty: No complete daily comparisons are available for this period.
weekExplanation: 2025 worldwide, forest and wildland. Share of new fires in the top five spots per region and day. Fire weather is NASA's fire-weather index [V].
weekSelectionCaveat: The week outlook method was chosen after scoring on 2025, so 2025 is not an untouched test of that choice. A later independent test is needed [U].
